Native dependencies, remote path configuration and keys affect runtime success.

rule_changes.placement: Neutral endpoint, format, SQL, configuration, module-reference and crypto operation observations moved to their subjects; local and exact consumers updated. Existing documented legacy leaves outside these corrections remain in place.
rule_changes.deduplication: Retired redundant double-index and numeric-coercion umbrella findings. Consolidated MSHTA/cmd path references and Discord target spellings with canonical neutral observations. Generic Discord target now includes stable and prerelease clients; consumers still require token/credential evidence.
rule_changes.new_behavior: Explicit fetch/JSON cookie-and-password body schema; hostile browser export requires credential decryption and forced process termination. Composite description explicitly states co-occurrence.
rule_changes.import_and_endpoint_controls: Use canonical engine AdmZip imports; billing endpoints require Discord host context. Current-user URL/path observations are consolidated under the service, without inferring OAuth.

validation.retained_obfuscation_controls: The shared benign-fixture validator prohibits suspicious objective traits. Both benign reduced coercion fixtures are therefore checked by the focused suite, which requires zero hostile findings while retaining accurate obfuscation.
